_comment: R0 scripted rc controls. Layout at RngRun 1, outageThreshold -1000: IMSIs 1,2 on cell 3 (gNB 3); IMSIs 3,4,5,6 on cell 2 (gNB 2). Steps are 10 periods apart (one handover takes ~2 ms of simulated time). via = the E2 node whose agent receives the control: the UE's serving gNB (its source en-gNB) for every positive; node 1 (the eNB) and a non-serving gNB appear only as negatives. key = the TS key of the target NR CGI, %08X10 (gNB ID, cell part 1, APER pad). Each control is E2SM-RC Style 5 action 3 naming the UE by its en-gNB-UEID, resolved from the IMSI at the control's step; it is stamped afterSeq = step by the pacer's `steps` gating. Negatives: step 60 through the non-source gNB 3 (refused unknownUe, ledger imsi 0); step 70 through the eNB, answered ran-function-id-invalid by its agent (no ledger line).
_calibration: T_ctl calibration: the four R0 controls plus six already-on-target refusals, ten complete trigger steps. A refusal still produces a controlRx and L ends before the outcome is decided, so the outcome cannot change L.
